_about: Heroine lines on the reward screens (docs/55, section 3), from the outside author. Each moment lists lines per heroine, shown in turn; the streak screen shows one line from each heroine for its milestone.

mika.en: Done for today! See you tomorrow.
That's today's list. All checked off!
mika.ru: Весь список на сегодня. Везде галочки!

mika.en: Nice work! Go enjoy your evening.
We did it! Tomorrow gets a fresh list.

rei.en: Done. That was quick.
All done. You can go now.
Good work. Call it a day.
Done already? Nice work.

iris.en: That takes care of today.
iris.ru: С делами на сегодня разобрались.

iris.en: You finished everything you meant to.
iris.ru: Ты закончил всё, что собирался.

iris.en: Everything's done. You can put it away.
iris.ru: Всё готово. Можно закрывать.

iris.en: Well done. I'll close my notebook too.
iris.ru: Молодец. Я тоже закрою тетрадь.

Hey! Let's ease back in today.
Good to see you! Where were we?
mika.ru: Рада тебя видеть! На чём мы остановились?

mika.ru: С возвращением! Начнём с маленького задания?

rei.en: Hey. Ready when you are.
rei.ru: Привет. Я готова, когда будешь готов.

rei.en: Welcome back. Want to start here?

Hey again. One thing at a time.
rei.ru: Снова привет. Давай по одному делу за раз.

iris.ru: Ты вернулся. Твоё место сохранено.

iris.en: Welcome back. Shall we pick up here?
iris.ru: С возвращением. Продолжим отсюда?

iris.en: Good to see you again.
iris.ru: Рада снова тебя видеть.

iris.en: We can start with something familiar.
iris.ru: Можем начать с чего-нибудь знакомого.

mika.en: Three days! Shall we go for four?
Three in a row! That's a start!
Day three! See you for day four.
You've done three days already!
mika.ru: У тебя уже три дня подряд!

rei.en: Three days. Good start.
Day three. You kept going.
Three in a row. Nice.
Three days down. Looking good.
rei.ru: Три дня позади. Пока всё отлично.

iris.en: Three days. You're finding your rhythm.
iris.ru: Три дня. Ты входишь в ритм.

iris.en: Three days in a row. Well done.
iris.ru: Три дня подряд. Молодец.

iris.en: Day three already. You settled in quickly.
iris.ru: Уже третий день. Ты быстро освоился.

iris.en: You made time for three days straight.
iris.ru: Ты находил время три дня подряд.

mika.en: Seven days! A whole week!
That's a week! Shall we start another?
Seven in a row! Look at you!
One full week! See you tomorrow.

rei.en: Seven days. That's a week.
A full week. Nice work.
Seven straight. I like those numbers.
rei.ru: Семь подряд. Мне нравятся эти цифры.

rei.en: Week one down. See you tomorrow.

iris.en: Seven days. That's a week of practice.
iris.ru: Семь дней. Неделя практики.

mika.en: Fourteen in a row! See you for fifteen.
That's two weeks! Put it on the calendar.

rei.en: Fourteen days. You're consistent.
Two weeks straight. Impressive.
Fourteen in a row. Good pace.
Two weeks. You've kept it going.
rei.ru: Две недели. Ты продолжаешь в том же духе.

Thirty in a row! We should celebrate.
Day thirty! Ready for thirty-one tomorrow?

rei.en: Thirty in a row. You earned that.

iris.ru: Тридцать дней ты находил время. Молодец.

mika.ru: Сто! Так, тут можно и поаплодировать.

iris.en: One hundred days of practice. I'm glad you stayed.

rei.en: You did it. Nice work.
Target hit. That's a good week.
You met the goal. Respect.
That's a win. Take it.
You put in the work. It shows.
Goal reached. Even I'm smiling.
Some practice still counts.
It's okay. Give yourself a break.
Rough week? We can try again.
rei.ru: Тяжёлая неделя? Можно попробовать ещё раз.

rei.en: You can leave it here for now.
